descriptions.w3d_d41e_write_bmp_801a4d68: Writes one mip level of a texture to a stream as an uncompressed BMP: picks bits per pixel from the texture format (failing with E_FAIL for unsupported ones), halves the size level times, fills the 14-byte little-endian file header and the 40-byte info header, writes a grey palette for 8-bit images, then writes each row through a new[] row buffer, swapping BGR or copying as the format requires. Standard BMP layout; other names inferred.
